textRuns.value: FLOW PERFORMANCE uses completed User Stories from the reporting month. All four delivery-health KPIs compare with the preceding complete month: Lead and Cycle Time are shown in days; Capacity Load and Delivery Defect Rate are shown in percentage points. Lower Lead Time, Cycle Time, and Delivery Defect Rate improve flow.

DELIVERY HEALTH combines the worst RAG (Red, Amber, Green) status across Lead Time, Cycle Time, Capacity Load, and Delivery Defect Rate. CURRENT QUEUE & CAPACITY SIGNALS use the current backlog and month-end snapshot; Active Testers are a state-based assignment proxy, not an HR tester count.
